(Gauḍa)ṣūrṇānandakavicakravartin
C. 17th Cent.; native of Bengal; disciple of Nārāyaṇa Bhaṭṭa.
--Tattvamuktāvalī or Māyāvādaśatadūṣaṇī.
Pt.. with Eng. transl. JRAS. 15 (1883) p.. 137-73.
--Laghubhāgavatāmṛta. BORI. 194 of 1892-95. Peters. V. p. 239 (no. 194).

(gauḍa)brahmānandasarasvatī
a. adv. writer of 18th cent.; disciple of Nārāyaṇatīrtha an. [Page099-b] Paramānandasarasvatī. See Preceptors of Advaita, p.. 323-27. Brahmānandīya noted below may be one of his works.
-C. Advaitacandrikā on Advaitabrahmasiddhi of Madhusūdana Sarasvatī. Bomb. Uni. Velankar 1160. Darbhanga 1085 (inc.). 1087 (inc.). Jaipur Mus. Ser. 2. p. 4. National Libr. Calcutta 537 (inc.). Ranbir II. p. 504. SB. New D.. VII. ii. 91611. 93039 (inc.). 93188 (inc.). Thiruvavadu 353.
Pt.. Varanasi.
-C. Gurucandrikā on Advaitabrahmasiddhi. See under the text.
Addl. mss.:
Bomb. Uni. Velankar 1160 (inc.). Darbhanga Raj 2613-14 (inc.). Mysore N. D. XI. 37397-98 (inc.). 37399 (inc.). SB. New D.. VII. ii. 92216 (inc.). Trav. Uni. Sup. 18690-D.
-C. Laghucandrikā or Gauḍabrahmānandīya on Advaitabrahmasiddhi of Madhusūdana Sarasvatī. See under (Gauḍa) Brahmānandīya below.
-Advaitasiddhāntavidyotana. See under the text.
